scope: Audit one NPI-owned immutable Released Trial Summary snapshot that freezes exact Trial Plan, Round, locked input, Trial Actual, Sample, cavity, defect, action, verification, comparison, controlled-reference and conclusion identities, versions and hashes without latest-value substitution.

Audit reuse of the existing P5-06 controlled-print registry, immutable snapshot and output mechanics, including exact language, actor, time, QR/hash, watermark, copy state, audited reprint and redaction truth.
Audit the NPI-side foundation for FR-INT-015 while keeping external event schema, routing, delivery, target projection and receipt confirmation held under DR-REC-009.
Keep formal production form mapping, signer, retention and copy policy behind DR-REC-003 and DR-REC-004, and keep released evidence distinct from approval, G7 authority or external execution.
Define the minimum complete vertical slice, ownership, additive persistence, closed BFF, trilingual industrial workspace, tests, migration and rollback before product code.
non_scope: Product implementation before the P7-07 audit and frozen plan pass.
External Released Trial Summary event publication, ERPNext or JCE projection, downstream delivery, target receipt confirmation or production form mapping.
Caller-supplied release, signer, retention, copy, watermark, source hash, translated enum or latest-source truth; raw private File URLs or unredacted controlled values.
Treating summary generation, controlled output or print evidence as approval, electronic signature, formal production acceptance, G7 close or Project lifecycle authority.

expected_state.controller_marker: P7-06 Level 2 PASS; P7-07 audit active

rollback.before_product_resume: Restore the P7-06 Level 2 checkpoint; the bounded P7-07 audit creates no product row, route, metadata, output or external effect.
rollback.after_product_resume: Use the rollback frozen in the accepted P7-07 plan; after retained summary or controlled-output history, disable only independent P7-07 routes and workspace and deliver a reviewed forward repair without rewriting summaries, outputs, source snapshots, receipts or audit history.
